rows.des_context: It was a morning cycling class that I took with a bunch of my suitemates. I would say I relate to the rush because it was at 8am and it was pretty early for all of us especially after staying up the night before. So we were rushing to get ready and also have something to eat beforehand. The frame is different from my experience because the girl in the frame is saying she's coming from a full day of classes, while in comparison to my situation, it was just an early morning.
rows.des_context_emo: I would say the character looks a bit out of breath and frantic to get to the archery class. I'm pretty sure I was frantic too, mainly cause we had never been to the location that the class was being held before.
rows.des_problem: It's almost the exact same, it was also my first rec class that was being held in main gym. Although I had been to main gym multiple times, I didn't know where this classroom specifically was. The friends that I had came with didnt know either. So all of us were checking the REC app to see if there was any specific instructions on how to get to that exact room. The main difference is that the character is navigating herself on her own, whilst I was with my friends and we were all working together to find the room.
rows.des_problem_emo: Shes holding a paper map and looks very confused. I would say I was also pretty confused but I was holding my phone.
rows.des_action: Its similar in the way that there was a third factor that directed us to where we needed to go. In this frame, the character sees the archery targets and a small paper sign pointing to the class. This is what had confirmed that she was in the right space. In comparison to my situation, my friends and I had given up on using our email confirmations to navigate us. We ended up going into main gym through the front doors and asking the person at the desk where the room was. She had given us pretty clear directions on how to get to the room and we got there with about 5 minutes to spare. Which was pretty good because it was about the perfect time to get settled on a bike and set up the seats to the best positions.
rows.des_action_emo: The character still seems like shes out of breath, you can tell by how shes slightly bent down at the torso, as if shes trying to catch some air. She also still seems stressed out rather than relieved. During my situation, after asking the person at the desk for help, I was pretty relieved that she told us exactly how to get to the room rather than just pointing in the rooms direction.
rows.des_resolution: The storyboard outcome seems a bit sad but it's pretty realistic. She was late and missed the introduction and safety instructions. This was different from my experice tho because we had gotten to the class with still time to adjust our seats and hear the safety instructions of the course. I wasn't really feeling behind. I remember other people coming in late during the class, the instructor simply approached them and helped them adjust their seat.
rows.des_resolution_emo: She seems pretty down about being late to the class and missing out on the intructuons and connection portion. I would say that I don't really relate to her emotions in this frame because I had came to the class with my friends. We also had no introductions during the class other than the instructor telling us her name and asking what music we wanted to cycle to.

rows.des_action_emo: I think I would be more irritated or frustrated than the character appears to be.

rows.des_context: Before the gym, I usually have some type of caffeine or some source of energy. I usually have an energy drink.

rows.des_problem: Definitely, the squat rack is one of the busiest machines that gets taken up in the gym or is rarely available. Most of the time I attend the gym I avoid using the squat rack because it's always taken up by gym bros who end up spending a lot of time on one squat rack.
rows.des_problem_emo: We are both let down because we intended to get a good leg day in and start off with the squat rack, but have to resort to moving to another machine or free weights.
rows.des_action: Typically, if one machine is busy for me in the gym, I do not change my entire workout I just tend to add on another workout using free weights that is aligned with that same muscle group I am intending to exercise.
rows.des_action_emo: We are both happy to at least find that there are other alternatives to workout and still get a solid workout in, even though it was not what we expected.
rows.des_resolution: I usually don't feel bad about skipping a leg/or upper body day I just alternate the next day with the muscle group I missed with a different workout.
rows.des_resolution_emo: I would say I am a little upset, but remain happy because I still got a workout in and I can always do a leg day the next day.

rows.des_context: I've gone in feeling energized and excited about what I was going to be targeting at the gym that day. Although, I usually don't start my workouts in the morning right after I drink coffee, my feelings are similar to the context here.

rows.des_problem: Sometimes I can relate when the gym is super busy. All the machines I like to use will be taken, and people will start forming lines for that specific one, letting others know they are next. Also, even with the smaller equipment like the dumbells and smaller weights.
rows.des_problem_emo: He feels immediately disheartened that all the stations and equipment are being used so now he will have to weight longer, possibly pushing his time back. This is similar to me because I'll have a specific schedule I'll want to follow that day and I'll be sad when things don't go as planned, or I'll have to completely miss our on some exercises as a whole.
rows.des_action: Similar to the character, I'll ask around to see how many sets someone has left on a specific machine, and whoever has the least, I'll wait for them to finish up. Or, I'll go out of the usual order in which I do my exercises and make a new plan with what's available.
rows.des_action_emo: He now feels calmer, easier to get through his workout once he has found some machines that are not in use. I feel the same once I start my workout, getting through the first exercise is always the hardest, but once you start and make a game plan in your head, it always gets better.
rows.des_resolution: I've also left not getting to complete the exercises I wanted to, or in the time frame I wanted to complete them in. Some things have also been skipped or swapped out for other ones, which makes you feel like you didn't give it your all.
rows.des_resolution_emo: It's a little saddening when you go in feeling motivated and ready to do a specific routine and then you leave not doing what you intended to, especially when it wasn't under your control. Yet, I always have my hopes high for next time, similar to the character.

rows.des_context: On my first day of classes last year, I enrolled in a Organic Chemistry lab super last-minute. Since I hadn't planned for this class, I had to rush to get to the other side of campus to be able to make it for the first day.
rows.des_context_emo: I was also anxious, running late, and in a rush to get to where I was trying to go.
rows.des_problem: It was also my first day of class for my Ochem lab, and once I got to York hall (the building that my lab class was supposedly in), I had a hard time finding the correct classroom. I went up and down several floors looking for it, and I eventually pulled out my phone to look at the UCSD virtual map and confirm the location.
rows.des_problem_emo: I was similarly confused and stressed as I tried to find the correct location I was running late to.
rows.des_action: When I get to a specific floor, I see two different signs pointing in opposite directions with different course codes on them to help guide students to the right CHEM classrooms for their respective lab courses. I was able to identify my course on one of these signs and follow the direction of the arrow.
rows.des_action_emo: The character seems tired and still looks stressed, which are both states that I could relate to during my experience.
rows.des_resolution: This frame resonated with me the most, since I also arrived late to the class. Specifically, since I had joined the class last minute and walked in late, I had not done any of the prelab assignments or watched any of the required safety videos. I had to spend the first hour of our first lab time rushing to complete those prerequisite assignments, as other students were able to work on their first lab, as planned.
rows.des_resolution_emo: The character seems disappointed and sad. I was also feeling these emotions, however I was still stressed (even more so now, since finding out about these incomplete assignments). I was also overwhelmed since I was rushing into doing these complex tasks and trying to catch up.

rows.des_problem: I relate a lot to this because there have been many times where the gym has been super crowded and it was hard to get to a machine and use it.
rows.des_problem_emo: They appear more worried, concerned, and distraught where I feel like I was more annoyed/aggravated since I wasn't able to get a turn in the machine.
rows.des_action: I feel like I've definitely had to pivot like this and change my workout routine or switching sets with other people. However, I wouldn't change what area I was working out, I would've continued to find leg machines than arm ones.
rows.des_action_emo: I feel like I would've been more annoyed than content/happy like him, especially if I had to switch from legs to arms.
rows.des_resolution: I would feel the same because I would be unsatisfied with the workout that I did. I would also want to go back to do my original workout and hope that it wouldn't be as crowded.
rows.des_resolution_emo: I feel like I'd feel the same, but possibly less sad and more exasperated/annoyed.

rows.des_context: I relate to what the character is doing because I have been in gyms before where this is too many people and its overcrowded.
rows.des_context_emo: The characters emotions in this frame compare to my own experience because I usually wake up early to go to the gym.
rows.des_problem: Being in a crowded room makes me feel anxious.
rows.des_problem_emo: The emotion and facial features of being overwhelmed in this context resonate with me.
rows.des_action: I relate to what this character is doing because I like to pivot in how I do things and accomplish tasks.
rows.des_action_emo: The characters emotions in this frame compare to my own because I feel confident when I pivot and happy as a result.
rows.des_resolution: I relate because when my plans don't go as planned I feel upset, even if I pivoted for the day.
rows.des_resolution_emo: They compare to my own because as previously mentioned I like a solid plan.

rows.des_context: I relate to this character in this storyboard because they are also attending an archery class for the first time, just like in my experience. They wanted to make it on time for class to learn new archery skills and make friends which is similar to my goals which was to learn more about archery and join the club.
rows.des_context_emo: The character felt behind and lost in the class due to their late arrival. My experience felt a bit similar and I felt left out and lost in the class because I attended the class solo.
rows.des_problem: It was the first class for the character in the story. In my experience, it was also my first class and it was a bit difficult to navigate to the big field.
rows.des_problem_emo: The storyboard character's emotions compares to my experience because I also felt lost and unsure of how to get to the archery field.
rows.des_action: I relate a bit to what the character tries to do in the third panel. I ended up making it to the archery class.
rows.des_action_emo: I don't think my experience can relate to this character's emotions on this panel.
rows.des_resolution: The character felt behind in class since she was late and also wasn't able to connect with her peers. I also felt behind in class since I had no prior experience in archery and didn't come with any friends.
rows.des_resolution_emo: The character seems a bit upset, which is kind of what I felt but in the end I tried reaching out to other people in the archery class.
